verdicts.reason: Both are the same shrunk copy of the original: the two decorative clusters are pushed out to the far edges and scaled down. That leaves wide empty yellow bands between them and the centre. The SALE circles and the 'NEW YEAR SPECIAL' headline are tiny for this banner, so the message is weak and it does not read left to right. B sets the headline higher, close to the top edge, with a looser gap above the SALE stack. A gives the headline a little more top margin, so it is marginally better balanced.
